# Privacy and Security Checklist: Launch the new doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate requirements for the contact endpoint, contact-submission data and the retirement of services that held personal data
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests requirement quality, not implementation. Governing principles: Constitution III, VII and VIII.

## Contact Endpoint on the Live Domain

- [ ] CHK001 Is "the contact endpoint responds" defined so the check cannot create a real submission or send a real message (method, expected status, no stored data)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK002 Are same-origin requirements specified for the new main origin and the `www` redirect, including which origins are accepted and rejected after launch? [Completeness, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it stated how the allowed-origin list changes once `new.doncoleman.ca` is removed, and when that happens relative to the switch? [Gap, Spec §FR-019a]
- [ ] CHK004 Are Turnstile hostname requirements specified for the live domain (widget hostnames, siteverify hostname check) as a launch prerequisite? [Gap, Dependency]
- [ ] CHK005 Are rate-limiting thresholds stated as unchanged or restated, so launch does not silently weaken them? [Consistency, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK006 Is Don's end-to-end contact test specified so the test message is identifiable, deleted afterwards and kept out of retention reporting? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it specified that production and preview submissions remain in separate D1 databases after the origin change? [Consistency, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the check's own traffic to the endpoint (frequency, from CI or local) bounded so it cannot trip rate limits? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]

## Contact-Submission Data and Retention

- [ ] CHK009 Is the privacy policy requirement updated to state the storage location and reflect the removal of Supabase and Ghost members as data holders? [Gap, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the legacy Supabase contact data classified (fields, record count, how long held) so Don can decide what to keep? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for where exported Supabase submissions and the Ghost members CSV are stored, who can access them and when they are deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it stated that exports are never committed, pasted into chat or logged, consistent with FR-007? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the retention period for kept legacy submissions consistent with the retention applied to D1 submissions? [Consistency, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the spec say whether the Ghost members list (subscriber personal data) is migrated, retained or destroyed, and what notice or basis applies? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK015 Are data-subject requests (access, deletion) addressed for data still in Ghost or Supabase during and after the migration window? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the minimal-collection requirement restated as unchanged, with no new personal data introduced by the analytics change on the apex? [Consistency, Constitution §VII, §X]

## Irreversible Deletion of Personal-Data Stores

- [ ] CHK017 Is the Supabase deletion gated by objective evidence of export completeness (record count match, file readable) rather than assertion? [Measurability, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK018 Do the identity-confirmation criteria for the Flux project distinguish it from Don's other Supabase project using at least two independent identifiers? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Is secret hygiene for the old stack defined: revoking or rotating Supabase, Mailgun and Ghost keys when each service is retired? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is removal of leftover secrets or environment values for retired services from GitHub and Cloudflare stores required? [Gap, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the archived Flux repository required to be checked for committed secrets or personal data before it stays cloneable? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]

## Security of the Cutover

- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements stated for subdomain takeover risk (dangling records pointing at Ghost, Mailgun or `new.doncoleman.ca` after retirement)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019a, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK023 Is HTTPS-only behaviour specified for the apex and `www`, with the HSTS decision and its rollback implications stated? [Gap, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the Cloudflare API token used by read-only setup checks (read-only scopes, storage, never printed in output or CI logs)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the CI preview crawl required to run without exposing any secret to untrusted pull-request code, including forks? [Gap, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the email authentication posture (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) required to remain valid after the Mailgun records are dropped, so spoofing protection is not weakened? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK027 Are logging requirements for the setup check and crawler stated so they never print message contents, personal details, tokens or `.env` values? [Gap, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK028 Is removal of the site-wide noindex bounded so `/api/*`, preview aliases and per-commit URLs stay unindexed, with that requirement explicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## Governance

- [ ] CHK029 Is the Principle III major-change classification stated with the specific triggers met, and is the preview-check item defined? [Traceability, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the Principle IX cost statement consistent between the spec assumptions and the plan's expected monthly cost, including Web Analytics and Actions minutes? [Consistency, Constitution §IX]
